title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Relationship Days Before a Pre-Owned Repossession Sale
content:
The customer's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract adds relationship days before the sale of a vehicle repossessed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract. Where the customer holds more than one active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract, the first one the retail lookup lists is the one read.

| The customer's active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract | Relationship days added |
|---|---|
| Active, no days past due | 7 (the current-relationship days) |
| Active, any days past due | 3 (the past-due-relationship days) |
| No active retail contract | none |

**Hypothetical.** A customer whose Kestrel New Vehicle retail contract is active and current adds 7 days; if that contract shows 4 days past due, 3 days; if it was paid off and none is active, none.
